items.title: Seasonality: S&P 500 average return by calendar month and how often each month is positive, 1971–2025
items.description: S&P 500 average return by calendar month, 1971–2025, with the share of years each month finished positive. November has been the best month on average (+1.71%) and was up in 70.9% of years.
items.reason: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are bouncing on Black Friday but are still on course for their worst November since 2008, in what is usually the strongest month of the year.

items.title: SpaceX operating income by segment (USD bn): Starlink profits vs AI and rocket losses
items.description: SpaceX operating income by segment. In the latest trailing 12 months Starlink earned $6.5bn while the AI segment (xAI, X) lost $5.5bn and the space/rocket segment lost $1.7bn.
items.reason: The FCC just cleared SpaceX to launch up to 1 million satellites as orbital AI data centers, and this chart shows Starlink profits are what pay for the AI and rocket losses.

items.title: Data Center Capacity (operational, GW)
items.description: Operational data center capacity by country, in gigawatts. The US has 32.0 GW, almost six times China's 5.5 GW; Japan (1.9), the UK (1.8) and India (1.6) follow, with Malaysia at 1.3 GW and Indonesia at 0.4 GW.
items.reason: Nvidia told server partners to halt shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US curbs on Chinese access to AI chips tighten, while chip stocks led today's rebound.

items.title: Strategy's STRC buybacks as a share of weekly STRC volume
items.description: Strategy's STRC repurchases as a share of weekly STRC trading volume, from 8-K filings: between 6% and 30% of each week's volume since mid-July, and 12% in the week of Nov 16.
items.reason: Strategy's latest 8-K showed $212M of STRC bought back against just $29.6M of bitcoin, and today's coverage is asking why its share sales now go to defending STRC instead of buying BTC.

items.title: 30-Day rolling Correlation: BTC vs Gold
items.description: 30-day rolling correlation of daily bitcoin and gold returns since late 2024. It peaked at 0.72 in September 2026, fell to about 0.23 in late October, and was back at 0.49 on Nov 20.
items.reason: Gold and silver rallied sharply this morning while bitcoin slipped back below $60,000, a fresh test of the digital-gold link.
